description_text: Program Analysis and Administrative Support Services COMNAVSURFPAC INSPECTOR GENERAL NAICS: 541330-1 - SB Size: $47.M PSC: R702 - POC: Jennifer Stevens, Contract Negotiator NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center San Diego Email: jennifer.k.stevens7.civ@us.navy.mil Type of Task Order: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) POP: 9 June 2026 – 8 June 2027 Duration: The requirement is for a base year and one 1-year option period. This Task Order is reserved only for Seaport NxG MAC holders Section 8 (a) Small Business set-aside. Proposals by other contractors will NOT be considered. The award resulting from this solicitation will be a Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Task Order. The Task Order will consist of a one-year base period with four, one-year option periods to be exercised at the discretion of the Government. The Contracting Officer will use Best-Value Tradeoff source selection process.
